item.title: Quality check of recycling container data in OpenStreetMap
item.description:
Simple app written in Golang to visualize tagging mistakes on recycling containers in the Czech Republic. It pulls data from Overpass API, then filters them and presents them using Leaflet.js. Data is converted to GeoJSON, compressed and sent to client.

http://thartek.alwaysdata.net/

source: https://github.com/BeranekP/osm-recycle

item.title: Invoice management for small entrepreneurs
item.description:
Simple app for creating and managing invoices, customers build with Python/Django and SQL database. Twilio Sendgrid is used for sending invoice over email.

Dashboard

Overview of last invoices and cashflow. Graph is made using Chart.js.

Invoice preview

HTML preview of the given invoice. Every invoice intended for bank transfer payment includes QR code for comfort of use. The app also supports payments in other currencies than CZK, exchange rates are pulled from Czech National Bank.
